subject: Quick follow-up on the benchmark report — demo scheduling
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@innovatica.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Benchmark report download — interested in a demo

Hi Lauren,

I downloaded the benchmark you published on inference latency/cost for mid-sized seq2seq models and would love a short walkthrough. We're evaluating options to replace a portion of our inference stack and want to understand how Redwood would behave at our scale (1–2M tokens/day, bursts during business hours).

Would a 30-min demo next week work? I'm in PST. Also cc'ing our CTO, Jacob, for schedule visibility.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Director of Machine Learning
Innovatica

Attachment: innovatica_benchmark_report.pdf (report they referenced)
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@innovatica.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 15:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Benchmark report download — interested in a demo

Hi Samira — great to hear from you and thanks for the download. I'm Lauren (Solutions) — happy to run a focused 30-min session that covers: how we measure latency/cost, routing/quantization options, and practical throughput knobs for steady vs bursty workloads.

I can do the following PST windows next week:
- Tue 12/7: 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed 12/8: 13:00–13:30

If none of those work, Ben (cc) will share a couple of open slots and a booking link.

Quick ask: could you paste one example peak hour QPS and a token-per-request estimate so we can tailor the walkthrough?

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.ai
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@innovatica.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Scheduling — Redwood demo for Innovatica

Hi Samira — Ben here on the SDR team. Thanks for reaching out and looping Jacob. If any of Lauren's proposed times work, reply and I'll lock it in. Otherwise, here's a short list of additional slots (PST):
- Tue 12/7: 11:00–11:30, 16:00–16:30
- Wed 12/8: 09:30–10:00, 15:00–15:30

Or you can pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.com/ben/redwood-demo (short link).

I'll include a calendar invite with a brief agenda once you confirm.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Development Rep, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira@innovatica.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@innovatica.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 08:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling — Redwood demo for Innovatica

Thanks Ben — we can take Tue 12/7 11:00–11:30 PST. Please include Jacob (CC'd). For context, peak hour is ~450 req/min averaging ~230 tokens/request. We'll want to touch on caching and fallback policies.

See you then,
Samira
From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@innovatica.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@innovatica.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: [Calendar invite] Redwood product demo — Tue 12/7 11:00 PST

Hi all — calendar invite attached and confirmed for Tue 12/7 11:00–11:30 PST. Agenda (brief):
- Intros & goals (5m)
- How we benchmarked the report & what it means for your traffic (10m)
- Deployment options + routing/caching knobs (10m)
- Q&A & next steps (5m)

Attachment: redwood-demo-invite.ics (calendar invite)

If you'd like any pre-reads, here's the report link again: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-innovatica-report

See you then — Dylan Brooks
Customer Success Ops (scheduling)
Redwood Inference
